note: 18 hook formulas for X. On X the first line is usually the whole post: people read it in the feed and decide in about a second. Each formula has a template, a filled example (illustrative only, never reuse an example's facts or numbers as the user's), what it is for, and the way it usually gets ruined.
rules: The first line must work alone. If it only makes sense after line 2, swap them.
One idea. Two ideas is a thread or two posts.
A number or a name beats an adjective.
If the hook still works with someone else's name on it, it isn't the user's hook.
No question in line 1 unless only this user could ask it.

hooks.name: Hot Take
hooks.template: {common belief in the niche} is wrong. {the one-line reason}.
hooks.example: "It works on my machine" isn't done. It's the start of the bug report.
hooks.best_for: TAKE posts. Highest reply rate, because people want to argue.
hooks.trap: Being contrarian about something nobody believes, or picking a fight you won't defend in the replies.

hooks.name: News + Take
hooks.template: {what happened, in one line}. {what it actually means for the reader}.
hooks.example: A lab just open-sourced a 1T-parameter model. Free to download, and you still can't run it at home.
hooks.best_for: NEWS posts. The take is the post. The fact only earns the read.
hooks.trap: A recap with no take. Recaps get ignored because 50 accounts post the same headline.

hooks.name: Build Log
hooks.template: Day {N} of building {thing}: {the one concrete thing that happened}.
hooks.example: Day 12 of building a habit tracker: moved sync to WebSockets and the lag went away.
hooks.best_for: BUILD posts. Gives followers a reason to come back tomorrow.
hooks.trap: "Made progress today". With no concrete change there's no post.

hooks.name: Bug Story
hooks.example: My game server died every 15 minutes. It wasn't a crash. The free tier was putting it to sleep.
hooks.best_for: BUILD and TIP posts. Devs repost bugs they've had.
hooks.trap: Burying the cause under setup. The cause is the punchline, so get there in two lines.

hooks.name: Command Drop
hooks.template: {problem in one line}. {the exact command or snippet}
hooks.example:
Find what's eating port 3000 on Windows:

netstat -ano | findstr :3000
hooks.best_for: TIP posts. The most bookmarked format for dev audiences.
hooks.trap: A command that doesn't work as written. Test it, or don't post it.

hooks.name: TIL
hooks.example: TIL Render injects PORT at runtime, so hardcoding 3000 works locally and fails silently in prod.
hooks.trap: A TIL everyone already knows. If it's in the first page of the docs, it isn't a TIL.

hooks.name: Before / After
hooks.example: Before: 4s to load the dashboard. After: 300ms. The change: stop re-rendering the whole table on every keystroke.
hooks.best_for: BUILD posts with a real measurement.
hooks.trap: Numbers that weren't measured. Never invent the before or the after.

hooks.name: Specific Question
hooks.template: {a question only someone doing the work would ask}
hooks.example: For multiplayer games on free hosting: WebSockets or polling? What actually held up for you?
hooks.best_for: QUESTION posts. Replies are the strongest signal on X.
hooks.trap: "What do you think about AI?" A question anyone could ask gets answered by nobody.

hooks.name: Poll
hooks.example: How much of your code does AI write now? 0-25% / 25-50% / 50-75% / 75%+
hooks.best_for: QUESTION posts when the answer is a choice. Voting is a one-tap reply.
hooks.trap: Options written as text lines instead of a native poll, or options that overlap.

hooks.name: Mistake
hooks.template: I {did the wrong thing} for {time}. {what it cost}.
hooks.example: I kept user sessions in server memory for a month. Every redeploy logged everyone out.
hooks.best_for: BUILD and TIP posts. Admitting a mistake earns more trust than a win does.
hooks.trap: A humblebrag dressed as a mistake. The cost has to be real.

hooks.name: Versus
hooks.template: {A} vs {B} for {specific job}: {verdict in one line}.
hooks.example: Flutter vs React Native for a 2-person team: Flutter, because one codebase actually stayed one codebase.
hooks.best_for: TAKE and TIP posts. Comparisons pull replies from both camps.
hooks.trap: No verdict. "Both have pros and cons" isn't a post.

hooks.name: Prediction
hooks.example: Calling it: by the end of 2027, most PR reviews will start with an AI pass.
hooks.best_for: NEWS and TAKE posts. People reply to agree, argue, or bookmark it to check later.
hooks.trap: A prediction too vague to ever be wrong.

hooks.name: Tiny List
hooks.example:
3 things that broke when my game went online:

- ports
- sleeping servers
- two players clicking at once
hooks.best_for: TIP posts. Fits 280 when the items are short.
hooks.trap: Seven items crammed into 280. Over 3 means it's a thread.

hooks.name: Paste the Error
hooks.template:
{the real error line}

{what it actually meant}.
hooks.example:
Error: listen EADDRINUSE :::3000

Translation: you already started it in another terminal. Again.
hooks.best_for: TIP and joke posts. Devs recognise the error before they read the rest.
hooks.trap: An error so obscure nobody has seen it.

hooks.name: Screenshot Caption
hooks.template: {one line that makes the image make sense} [image]
hooks.example: The moment two users edit the same row in the same millisecond: [screenshot]
hooks.best_for: BUILD posts. An image of your real UI or terminal stops the scroll.
hooks.trap: A caption that describes the image. Say what the image can't.

hooks.name: Observation
hooks.template: {a true, specific thing everyone in the niche has noticed but not said}.
hooks.example: Every side project has a README with a Roadmap section that has never been updated.
hooks.best_for: FLEX posts. Short, funny if possible, and reposted for being relatable.
hooks.trap: Being mean about a specific person or company.

hooks.name: Milestone
hooks.template: {honest small number} {thing}. {what changed because of it}.
hooks.example: First 3 strangers used my CLI last night. One found a bug in 4 minutes.
hooks.best_for: BUILD posts. Small honest numbers beat vague big claims.
hooks.trap: Inflating the number, or a milestone with no story.

hooks.name: Ask for Help
hooks.template: {specific problem I'm stuck on}. {what I tried}. {the exact question}.
hooks.example: My Render server sleeps after 15 min idle. Tried a GitHub Action ping. Is there a cleaner free option?
hooks.best_for: QUESTION and BUILD posts. People love solving a concrete problem in public.
hooks.trap: Not saying what you tried, so every reply suggests the obvious thing.
